question: Which of the following is a synthetic fluorinated compound with an extremely stable molecular structure known to be the most potent greenhouse gas ever found?
solution:
The correct answer is __**sulphur hexafluoride.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Sulphur hexafluoride **is a **synthetic fluorinated gas** with an **extremely stable molecular structure**, making it the **most potent greenhouse gas** ever found.
